meta.description: S6 demo artifact -- an importable n8n workflow that receives a RESILIX ERP_CASE dispatch. RESILIX POSTs a sanitized DIGEST-ONLY JSON body {actionType, channel, idempotencyKey, ...digest} to this webhook AFTER a human approves the packet; nothing reaches this workflow before approval, and RESILIX is never in the approval loop (n8n is a pure outbound sink). AUTH (fail-closed, 2026-07-16): the guard requires the X-Resilix-Webhook-Secret header to match the RESILIX_WEBHOOK_SECRET n8n environment variable -- with the variable unset, EVERY call is rejected, so an imported workflow is never open by accident; set the same value in RESILIX's N8N_ERP_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME/VALUE. RESPONSE (2026-07-16): the webhook responds via Respond-to-Webhook nodes AFTER the guard and ERP step run -- 200 only when the guarded work completed, 403 on a bad secret or malformed payload -- so RESILIX's delivery receipt never records success for work that failed. Idempotency: the idempotencyKey field dedupes a re-driven dispatch, so this workflow must upsert on it, never blind-insert.
